notes.title: Release date October 22!
notes.notes:
Meowphoria will be released on — October 22!



Unique and interesting features:

The game will feature 12 cute catgirls, each with their own unique combat skills and character!

Use the “Harem Summon” ability to immediately teleport up to 4 selected catgirls from your harem to you.

Locations - full of activitiesand secrets.

Exciting boss battles, where you - not alone!

Funny dialogues with answer options are combined with a deep story.

Funny madness and hardcore achievements!

notes.title: The release is closer than ever!
notes.notes:
A fun and crazy metroidvania with the ability to summon a whole harem of cute catgirls is coming soon!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831978/e0422183b2b24bbd24f1231e0b636c4e6113c973.png"]

notes.title: Meowphoria now has a demo version!
notes.notes:
After a long time of all sorts of doubts, I finally decided to publish a publicly available demo version of Meowphoria!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831978/3a4694dda3f7041c4626a08eaf8ad8dbaecf87f0.jpg"]

In this short (about 10 minutes of gameplay) trial version, you can test the initial gameplay, fight 2 bosses and meet some of the characters~...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831978/24cd071caddcd14138c499cef55939980ba86c8e.jpg"]

The release will definitely not be this summer, so add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss the release meowment ;3

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831978/071e9c31362cf542c93072dadb7b8b86ee7ed968.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831978/9ea1a4746c92fca9f535c1a55956e8e936556465.png"]

notes.title: New trailer and release coming soon!
notes.notes:
Dates with cute catgirls and epic metroidvania! Meowphoria is coming - add it to your wishlist and don't miss out on the meowment! :3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831978/6858b616dde8f6f22c6117620e53d62070256e69.jpg

A new trailer was posted on the official YouTube channel, this time a really full-fledged trailer showing all the delights of the gameplay and visuals: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CCTEWQnGXYY

As you already know, I am making Meowphoria completely alone and at the moment almost no one knows about the game, so I would be grateful if you share news about the game with your friends or you can just fishlist ;3
